record_title: Subfield-rank obstruction for identical leakage under linear computations
provenance: A structural analysis of identical B-linear leakage for the computation-code framework of Aoutouf--Augot, arXiv:2609.19929, based on restricting the product code to one-dimensional families of input codewords and measuring the B-span of computation-code coordinates.
limitations: The subfield-rank condition is a necessary obstruction, not a sufficient criterion when the minimum rank exceeds one. The result does not establish existence for quotient-independent weighted sums and is restricted to linear leakage over finite fields. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.19929 is very recent.
